objective: LungVision AI — Phase 2B Multi-Patient Statistical Shape Model (SSM) Training, Validation, and Full-Stack Research Integration.
acceptance_criteria: Gate A: Pre-Flight Data & Label Governance (Reconcile label schemas across LUNA16 Grand Challenge and Thoracic Reference; audit 445 scans down to 430 verified; 0 patient leakage across 70/15/15 train/val/test split).
Gate B: Canonical Template & Organic Curvature (Design 6,737-vertex canonical lung mesh with 16 anatomical landmarks and bilateral partitioning).
Gate C: Generalized Procrustes Alignment (GPA alignment across 301 training cohort shapes with 100% registration convergence).
Gate D: PCA Basis & Eigenspace Verification (Fit 20 modes on training cohort with 100.0% variance explained; Top 5 modes capture 90.38%; zero leakage verified).
Gate E: Held-Out Generalization Evaluation (Validate on 64 val and 65 test unseen patients: ASSD <= 2.5 mm, HD95 <= 7.0 mm, Vol Error <= 7.5%, Surface Dice >= 0.85).
Gate F: Lightweight Model Serialization (Export ssm_lung_pca_v1.json at 4.36 MB, well under 15 MB limit; sync to backend runtime).
Gate G: Full-Stack Integration & Research Panel (Expose /ssm/deform endpoint; add Tab 5 in CTExplorerPage with physiological mode sliders, volumetry, metrics, and scientific disclaimer).
Gate H: Full Test Suite Verification (46/46 pytest tests passed; 26/26 vitest tests passed; clean production build with 0 TypeScript errors).
non_goals: Do not delete existing models, checkpoints, masks, or research assets
Do not download 220 GB LUNA16 collection locally; use cloud-hybrid execution
Do not claim SSM synthesizes diagnostic CT Hounsfield Units or internal tissue
